features.title: Native Capture
features.summary: Screen and window capture implemented in Rust for improved performance and reliability.
features.description: Capture screen or windows with a native backend and a stable desktop app runtime.

features.title: Selection & Preview
features.summary: Pick a capture source and see a live preview during recording.
features.description: Select a screen or window source and confirm everything looks right before hitting record.

media.alt: Selecting a source and previewing before recording

features.title: Webcam Integration
features.summary: Camera capture with a draggable overlay and layout controls.
features.description: Enable your webcam and drag it to position; adjust layout so it matches your style.

features.title: Audio Handling
features.summary: Microphone capture and integrated audio processing.
features.description: Record narration from your microphone and keep it synced in exports.

features.title: Notes Overlay
features.summary: Add multiple notes during recording and switch using shortcuts.
features.description: Keep on-screen prompts while recording and flip between notes without breaking your flow.

features.title: Floating Controls
features.summary: Start/stop from an external recorder overlay while focused on other apps.
features.description: Control recording without switching back to the main window.

features.title: Screenshot Export
features.summary: One-click export of a preview screenshot.
features.description: Grab a crisp still from your preview for docs, slides, or thumbnails.

features.title: Project Management
features.description: Return to previous sessions and keep work organized by project.

features.title: Review Workflow
features.description: Trim segments and review recordings with an editing-focused timeline experience.

features.title: Smart Zoom
features.summary: Click-to-zoom and timeline-based zoom events with cursor-follow logic.
features.description: Add zooms around important interactions and keep focus where it matters.

features.title: Cursor Customization
features.summary: Highlight/replace cursor and import custom cursor packs.
features.description: Make the cursor easier to follow in demos by styling it or swapping in a custom pack.

features.title: Visual Styling
features.summary: Backgrounds (solids, gradients, images) and visual themes.
features.description: Match your brand with theme colors and flexible backgrounds.

features.title: Captions
features.summary: Transcription pipeline with adjustable caption styling.
features.description: Generate captions and control size, color, and visibility for readability.

features.title: Cinematic Effects
features.summary: Cursor glide, motion blur, smooth zoom, and auto-hide for professional polish.
features.description: Add professional polish with cursor smoothing, motion blur trails, seamless zoom transitions, and intelligent cursor hiding when idle.

features.title: Export Options
features.description: Choose an output format based on where you’ll publish: web, social, or docs.

features.title: Presets
features.summary: Resolution and frame-rate presets for exports.
features.description: Quickly pick settings like 1080p/4K and 30/60fps without manual math.

features.title: Render Control
features.summary: Track render progress and cancel when needed.
features.description: See progress during export and cancel long renders safely.
